notes: kb/Work PB5925 step 4a. §2023:7.3.12.4 GR2: "If the compiler does not produce a source listing, the result of the DISPLAY directive is defined by the implementor, otherwise the data transfer shall take place irrespective of whether it is suppressed by the LISTING directive." Both halves are live: with a listing the transfer is placed in the listing at its directive and printed there even when a LISTING OFF suppresses the directive's line (Listing2023Tests); with none it is a Listing-stream transfer the CLI writes to standard output (DOC-A.1-53, GnuCOBOL precedent). The directive is edition-gated (COBOL0900 below 2023). retired-witness: unit:DisplayDirectiveTests.NoUponPhrase_IsAsIfUponListing_WhichIsStandardOutput (renamed unit:DisplayDirectiveTests.NoUponPhrase_IsAsIfUponListing by kb/Work PB5925 step 4a: the LISTING destination is now the listing when one is produced, so the case no longer names standard output)
